clue.text: Very exciting case in court, absolutely full

parts.note: a lawsuit is an action
a room absolutely full is packed

explanation.surface: A thrilling trial with a crowded courtroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A film or story crammed with thrilling events is described with this compound adjective.

clue.text: Distinctly superior cave about to be transformed

indicators.note: something to be transformed will change form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cave about to be renovated into something rather better.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes something clearly better than the rest, a notch higher in quality.

clue.text: Go and fish below the old road

indicators.note: in a down answer the fish is placed below the word for go

parts.note: a go or turn in a game
the pike is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler told to fish beneath an ancient highway.
explanation.definitionFit: A road on which a toll gate once stood, historically a main highway, is so named.

clue.text: Give instructions for tidiness

definitions.meaning: an arrangement where everything is in its place

explanation.surface: A parent telling the children to tidy up.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to command someone and a neat, methodical arrangement.

clue.text: Range of investments: poor lot, if badly managed

indicators.note: a badly managed set of letters is put in a different order

explanation.surface: An investor's holdings, a sorry lot because of poor management.
explanation.definitionFit: The collection of assets an investor holds is the financial term for that spread.

clue.text: Cold countryside at first and not flat

indicators.note: at first picks the opening letter of countryside

parts.note: land that is not flat is hilly

explanation.surface: Rolling countryside with a nippy breeze.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpleasantly cool weather is a plain synonym for cold.

clue.text: Proclamation wrongly cited

indicators.note: letters put wrongly are out of order, so rearrange them

explanation.surface: A royal announcement quoted inaccurately.
explanation.definitionFit: An official order issued by authority is a formal public announcement.

clue.text: Counter on which one may tell one's beads?

definitions.text: on which one may tell one's beads?
definitions.meaning: to tell beads is to count them, usually saying prayers on a rosary

explanation.surface: A shop counter where someone tells rosary beads.
explanation.walkthrough: Telling one's beads is praying with a rosary; here tell has its old sense of count.
explanation.definitionFit: A frame of sliding beads on wires is an ancient calculating device.

clue.text: Quickly buy pans suggested

parts.note: the answer, written going up in a down light, makes SNAP read upwards, giving the clue word

explanation.surface: Grabbing some cookware at a bargain, as the seller suggests.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer read as instructions, SNAP placed UP, spells out the clue word; suggested links the two.
explanation.definitionFit: To seize a bargain eagerly is the phrasal verb, buying before anyone else can.

clue.text: Sky thus clearer, as university sportsman runs

parts.note: a Blue is a sportsman who has represented Oxford or Cambridge
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Weather improving as an athlete from the university goes jogging.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is an Oxford or Cambridge student who has competed against the other university.
explanation.definitionFit: When cloud lifts, the sky takes on a deeper azure colour, so it is more so in hue.

clue.text: Australian who believes in evolution?

definitions.meaning: a person from Darwin, capital of Australia's Northern Territory
a follower of the naturalist who proposed natural selection

explanation.surface: An Aussie who holds with evolutionary theory.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a resident of the northern Australian city and a supporter of the theory of natural selection.

clue.text: One showing appreciation of tongue

definitions.meaning: the hanging striker inside a bell is called its tongue

explanation.surface: Someone praising another's language or way of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: One meaning is a person who applauds; the other is the swinging metal piece that strikes a bell.

clue.text: Pen — only touched one end?

parts.note: to have touched something is to have felt it
a tip is one end of something

explanation.surface: Someone who handled a pen by just one end.
explanation.definitionFit: A marker whose writing point is made of compressed fibre is named for that point.

clue.text: Where one was punished, until completely motionless

parts.note: offenders were once locked by the feet in the stocks
till means until

explanation.surface: An offender locked in the pillory, unable to move until released.
explanation.walkthrough: The stocks were a wooden frame in which offenders were held by the ankles for public humiliation.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing utterly without movement is described by this idiom, as rigid as a post.

clue.text: Refund from the Revenue?

parts.note: money coming back from the tax office, though the form you send them has a name that sounds just like it

explanation.surface: Hoping for money back from the taxman.
explanation.walkthrough: The Revenue is the UK tax authority; the document sent to it is not a refund, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The annual statement of income filed with the tax authorities has this name, return punning on money coming back.

clue.text: Change feet over

indicators.note: over signals turning the word for feet round, read backwards

parts.note: animals' feet are paws

explanation.surface: Swapping one's feet over, as a dancer might.
explanation.definitionFit: To exchange one thing for another is a simple verb synonym of change.

clue.text: Suddenly turn to make a collection

definitions.meaning: a gathering of money among colleagues for a gift

explanation.surface: Someone swivelling to pass the hat around.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain an office collection for a leaving present is a common custom.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means spin about fast; as a noun it is an informal office fund-raising.

clue.text: Picture that striker quickly takes

definitions.meaning: a quick, unprepared attempt on goal by a footballer

explanation.surface: A photo of a football forward taken in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal photograph and a sudden football strike at goal share the name.

clue.text: Witches can't start cooker

indicators.note: the word for witches cannot have its start, so its opening letter is dropped

parts.note: a gathering of witches is a coven

explanation.surface: Witches unable to light the stove for their brew.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosed compartment for baking and roasting is a part of a kitchen cooker.

clue.text: Secret business, turning up at sect

indicators.note: in a down answer, turning up reads the letters for business from the bottom

parts.note: CO is short for company, a business
a cult is a sect

explanation.surface: Clandestine company dealings coming to light within a sect.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge hidden from all but initiates is mysterious and esoteric, hence secret.

clue.text: Setting out virtues of joining euro?

definitions.meaning: praise for making sterling a former currency

explanation.surface: Someone laying out the case for Britain adopting the single European currency.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word as EX-POUND-ING: making the pound an ex-currency.
explanation.definitionFit: To set out an argument is to explain it at length, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Fuel kept without pressure seal

parts.note: gas is a fuel

indicators.note: without signals taking a letter away from the word kept

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Gas stored unpressurised behind a seal.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat ring of rubber or similar material is a seal between two joined surfaces.

clue.text: Sort of school for everyone? Yes and no

definitions.text: Sort of school for everyone? Yes and no

parts.words: Sort of school for everyone? Yes and no
parts.note: the name says open to all, yet such schools in Britain are private and fee-paying

explanation.surface: A paradox about whether a type of school is open to all.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the term names exclusive fee-paying schools such as Eton, despite its literal meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means for everyone, and in British usage it labels elite private schools.

clue.text: The arts of growing lab specimen?

definitions.meaning: music, painting, literature and so on, taken together
bacteria grown in a dish in a laboratory

explanation.surface: Wondering whether the arts are something grown in a laboratory.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both artistic activity collectively and cells grown in a nutrient medium.

clue.text: Rope, look, tethering donkey

indicators.note: tethering signals the word for look holding the word for donkey within it

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A rope being used to tie up a donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope with a running noose, used by cowboys to catch cattle, is a kind of rope.

clue.text: Prime us acting for those standing in the middle

indicators.note: acting suggests the letters are performing a different role, so rearrange them

explanation.surface: Actors playing prime ministers, standing centre stage.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the officials stand in the middle of the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket officials stand out on the central pitch, so they are those standing there.

clue.text: Escort drug dealer for execution

indicators.note: execution here means beheading, so the word for drug dealer loses its head letter

parts.note: a pusher sells drugs

explanation.surface: A guard leading a drug dealer to his execution.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who shows people to their seats or guides them in is a verb or noun synonym of escort.

clue.text: No more jokes after this, said to be the longest?

definitions.text: No more jokes after this, said to be the longest?

parts.words: No more jokes after this, said to be the longest?
parts.note: the proverb says that he who laughs ... longest, and nothing follows the final chuckle

explanation.surface: A comedian's closing quip, reputedly the most enduring.
explanation.definitionFit: The final triumph after others have mocked is the idiom, from the proverb about who laughs longest.

clue.text: Half hope to take advantage of building

indicators.note: half of a four-letter word is its first two letters

parts.note: to use someone is to take advantage of them

explanation.surface: Half-hoping to profit from a property.
explanation.definitionFit: A dwelling is a kind of building, the general term standing for the specific one.

clue.text: Need contract revised but not watered down

indicators.note: a revised document has its contents reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A contract needing rewriting, but its terms not weakened.
explanation.definitionFit: Something undiluted is strong and condensed, the opposite of being thinned with water.
